meta.title: Brisk — Custom websites, webshops, software and apps
meta.description: Brisk is a digital agency from Belgium. More than {total} custom websites, webshops and software built over {years} years. We reply within 24 hours.

hero.lead: Custom websites, webshops, software and mobile apps. Designed and built by one agency in Belgium, for companies that want to get ahead.
hero.videoLabel: Background film: someone working on a laptop on a cliff above the clouds

services.title: Four things. All of them custom.
services.lead: No themes, no page builders. Every project starts with what your customer needs and ends in code you own outright.

websites.title: Custom websites
websites.description: Fast, findable and built around what your customer came for.

webshops.title: Custom webshops
webshops.description: An ordering flow without friction, from product page to payment.

software.title: Custom software
software.description: Portals, dashboards and tools that shorten your working day.

apps.title: Mobile apps
apps.description: Apps for iOS and Android that feel like they belong on the phone.

work.title: Work that is live today.
work.lead: A handful of the {total}+ websites, webshops and platforms we have built. What you see here is a selection, not concepts or mockups.

motion.title: From homepage to checkout.
motion.body: A quick tour of a handful of references, exactly as they are online today.

product.title: Interfaces people enjoy working in.
product.lead: More than fifty screens for dashboards, apps and internal tools. Designed to the pixel and then built exactly as designed.

process.title: Four steps, no surprises.
process.body: You talk directly to the people who design and build. Every step ends with something you can see, click and judge for yourself.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: We start with a free thirty-minute call. What you want to achieve, for whom, and what is standing in the way. From that comes a clear proposal with scope and timeline.

design.title: Design
design.body: Structure first, visuals second. You see real screens instead of vague moodboards and give feedback on something you can click through.

build.title: Build
build.body: We write custom code, without themes or plugins that work against you later. Fast, accessible and ready to grow. You follow progress on a staging site.

launch.title: Launch & grow
launch.body: Going live is the start. We measure what works, improve what can be better and stay reachable. You get an answer to any question within 24 hours.

why.title: Small team, direct contact, our own code.
why.lead: One small team that designs and builds. You always know who you are talking to and what happens in the next step.

contact.title: Direct contact, no account managers
contact.body: You email or call the people doing the work. Questions get an answer within 24 hours, from someone who knows your project inside out.

ownership.title: Our code, your property
ownership.body: Everything we design and build is yours: design files and code. No subscription to your own website.

pace.title: Fast, never rushed
pace.body: We work in short, visible steps. You see results early and decide based on real screens instead of assumptions.
